purpose: Establish and validate the quantitative measurement methodology used downstream of the frozen LV segmentation model.
method_selection_principle: Geometry methods will first be evaluated using ground-truth LV masks so that measurement-model error is separated from segmentation error.
test_exposure_note: The current 50-patient evaluation partition was previously inspected during historical pilot development. It was excluded from the clean Phase 1A-1D model-selection process, but is not claimed to be a pristine external test set.
